memory: I believe that leadership in finance is about creating a culture of excellence while maintaining humanity. By empowering my team members, holding them accountable for their actions, and fostering continuous growth, I aim to create an environment where innovative ideas can thrive. I encourage open communication and challenge conventional thinking, as I believe that the best ideas often come from unexpected places. By hosting a weekly 'strategic roundtable' where team members can present their investment theses or operational improvements, I ensure that everyone has a platform to contribute. This approach has already led to the implementation of a novel approach to ESG scoring proposed by a second-year analyst.
